title: Stacked statutory events (A1-A4)
kill_reason: Not run (lead decision 2026-11-06). The plan's literal condition (Execution step 6: at least two A-family registries frozen) was met: A1, A2 and A3 froze registries. The lead read the condition as requiring at least two A-family designs that proceeded past design; only A1 did (A2 and A3 were killed at design, A4 at triage). This is a recorded deviation from the plan.
